direction.name: 林间木牌玩具
direction.summary: 原创圆润小浣熊与木质市场，使用低细节高辨识的平面图形
direction.characterStyle: 用圆头、小三角耳、原创面纹和短腿构成的简化小浣熊，不模仿任何已有角色
direction.environmentStyle: 顶视木质货架、布棚与叶片形地面标记，路线宽阔且交互圈清晰
direction.uiStyle: 深青半透明胶囊面板配米白文字和黄色数字，只显示核心状态
direction.iconConcept: 一只原创小浣熊抱着黄色果篮，背后是抽象绿叶屋顶
direction.previewPrompt: Original mobile game art direction sheet for a top-down forest produce shop run by a cute red panda, rounded geometric 2D vector shapes, wooden stalls, banana and corn products, warm readable palette, no logos, no resemblance to any existing game

changes: Use an original red panda instead of a monkey
Use an original forest stall layout and leaf-token economy
Use original unlock pacing and values
notes: This is a functional vertical slice style lock, not final production art
Favor clarity and local action feedback over decoration
